value: **Involvement**: Teachers partnered with researchers in an iterative collaborative design process to conceptualize, author, and contextualize curricular materials and learning activities tailored to their classroom environments. **Evidence**: "The literature positions educators not merely as instructors but as co-designers, facilitators, and technology brokers who adapt curricula to local needs and learn alongside students (Chiu et al., 2024)."
